description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for validating the handling of submodule URLs and configurations in Git. It tests various scenarios such as URL scheme correctness, protection of certain URL patterns, handling of special characters and embedded newlines, and validation of URL formatting during Git push operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects a specific command sequence to succeed.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a cleanup command to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case where the specified command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern matches in command output, ignoring case or other specified flags.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates time passing, typically used for timestamp purposes inside tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

calls: git commit -m "gitmodules with missing URL scheme"
git checkout --orphan ... (and other comments for cleanup)
